name: Our Lady of Possibility
source:
The hyperactive and witty Billie is fresh out of college and completely lost on what to do in her life. She is incredibly protective as a friend and sharp tongued as an enemy, but don't worry, she's more bark than bite - she talks big to hide her insecurities. And she's got a LOT of insecurities.

[From [url=https://banana-ooyu.itch.io/one-just-night]itch.io[/url]]
